title: Project: Build a Complete Web Page Using HTML
description: Apply all your HTML knowledge to build a fully structured and semantic web page, including multimedia, forms, and JavaScript integration.

lessons.title: Project Overview and Requirements
lessons.content: Learn the project goals: create a multi-section web page with header, navigation, main content, images, forms, and JavaScript interactions.

lessons.content:

</head>

</body>
</html>

lessons.title: Testing and Debugging Your Page
lessons.content: Learn how to test your web page on different browsers and devices, use browser developer tools to inspect and debug HTML and JavaScript.

lessons.title: Project Submission and Next Steps
lessons.content: Review your project, prepare documentation, and explore how to enhance your page further with CSS and React in upcoming courses.
